LanguageData.XPC_ProfileDialog_OverwriteWarning: Overwrite this profile’s saved XP settings with your CURRENT settings? The profile name and identity stay the same. A backup will be retained.

LanguageData.XPC_ProfileDialog_RenameStorageFailure: Rename failed: {0}. Check the backup before retrying.

LanguageData.XPC_ProfileDialog_CreateInvalidProfile: Profile validation failed; nothing was saved.
